channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Applications open for free and reduced-price school meals in Indian River County
item.description: Families in Indian River County can apply for free or reduced-price meals for students starting July 15. item.title: Hobe Sound couple seeks community support as husband battles head and neck cancer
item.description: A Hobe Sound couple is asking for community support as Dave Motz battles head and neck cancer. The couple has faced nearly $20,000 in out-of-pocket medical costs while traveling to Orlando for daily radiation treatments.

item.title: Free and reduced-price meal applications open for Indian River County students
item.description: Families in Indian River County can apply for free or reduced-price meals for students starting July 15. Students at six Indian River County schools can receive free meals during the 2026-2027 school year through federal nutrition programs.

item.description: The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office announced Tuesday that a second person has been arrested in the fatal shooting of Fort Pierce art teacher Andre Leonard Barnes, 66. Dale A. item.title: Pickup truck fire closes lane on Florida's Turnpike in St. Lucie County
item.description: St. Lucie County Fire District crews responded Monday morning to a fully involved Ford F-250 pickup truck fire on Florida's Turnpike Northbound near Mile Marker 175.

item.title: Port St. Lucie soccer stadium groundbreaking set for November, 6,000-seat venue at Walton & One development
item.description: Port St. Lucie SC released new renderings this week of its 6,000-seat stadium at the Walton & One development on U.S. 1 and Walton Road. Groundbreaking is anticipated in November with current plans targeting a 2028 opening.

item.title: Port St. Lucie City Council to vote on commercial rezoning near Tradition despite neighbor concerns
item.description: A proposal to change nearly 9.5 acres near Crosstown Parkway and SW Fairgreen Drive from residential to commercial use is scheduled for a second reading and final vote before Port St. Lucie City Council Monday.

item.title: Hobe Sound couple seeks support as husband battles head and neck cancer
item.description: Dave and Faren Motz of Hobe Sound are asking for community support as they navigate a cancer diagnosis. Dave was diagnosed with head and neck cancer just months after the couple moved to the area.

item.title: Fort Pierce residents pack planning meeting over 17-story Causeway Cove high-rise proposal
item.description: The Fort Pierce Planning Board reviewed the Causeway Cove development project on Monday as neighbors packed the chamber. item.title: World Cup semifinals set as England and Argentina advance to final four
item.description: England's Jude Bellingham netted twice to inspire his team past Erling Haaland's Norway, while Argentina's Julin Alvarez scored in extra time to help the team past Switzerland.

item.title: Jannik Sinner wins second straight Wimbledon title, defeating Alexander Zverev
item.description: The top-ranked tennis player beat Alexander Zverev in four sets Sunday after his German opponent appeared bothered by a knee issue following a slip to the grass.

item.title: Linda Noskova wins Wimbledon after recovering from five blown match points
item.description: The 21-year-old Czech player recovered from a second-set meltdown to overcome Karolina Muchova 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 in an all-Czech final Saturday.

item.title: Justin Bieber, Madonna, Shakira and BTS to headline World Cup final halftime show
item.description: The 11-minute halftime performance will take place during the final outside New York on July 19, curated by Coldplay's Chris Martin.

item.title: Port St. Lucie 6,000-seat soccer stadium groundbreaking set for November at Walton & One
item.description: Port St. Lucie SC released new renderings this week of its 6,000-seat soccer stadium, with representatives announcing Friday that groundbreaking is anticipated for November at the Walton & One development. item.title: Man fleeing ICE agents struck and killed by truck on Florida State Road 16
item.description: A 28-year-old man died Tuesday after being struck by a semi trailer truck while fleeing from U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents on State Road 16 in Florida. The man was one of four people who ran from the scene during an encounter with ICE and Homeland Security Investigations agents in

item.title: Three lawsuits challenge Florida property tax amendment ballot language before November vote
item.description: A Republican-backed property tax amendment headed to Florida voters in November faces three separate legal challenges over whether the ballot language fairly explains the measure or amounts to a political sales pitch.

item.title: Florida Democrats cite special election wins as evidence of possible legislative comeback in 2026
item.description: Florida Democrats say recent special election victories and increased volunteer activity show the Republican supermajority in the state Legislature is breakable, though the party still faces a voter registration deficit of more than 1.5 million.

item.title: Rising home insurance costs driving Florida voter turnout ahead of 2026 midterms, study finds
item.description: A new study shows 65 percent of Florida respondents say rising insurance costs are making them more likely to vote in the 2026 midterm elections, higher than the national average of 58 percent.

item.title: Judge sets July 21 hearing on lawsuit challenging James Fishback residency in Florida governor's race
item.description: A Leon County judge scheduled a two-day hearing for July 21 and 22 to decide whether Republican gubernatorial candidate James Fishback meets Florida's seven-year residency requirement to run for governor.

item.title: Former Florida gubernatorial candidate Andrew Gillum arrested on drug charges in Alabama
item.description: Former Tallahassee mayor and 2018 Florida gubernatorial candidate Andrew Gillum was arrested July 2 in Daphne, Alabama, on marijuana and methamphetamine possession charges after police stopped him for erratic driving.

item.title: Florida's annual Python Challenge begins with $10,000 prize for invasive snake removal
item.description: The 10-day Florida Python Challenge runs from July 10 through July 19, offering hunters a $10,000 grand prize for removing the most invasive Burmese pythons from the Everglades ecosystem.

item.title: Martin County brush fires contained after lightning strike, but more expected this summer
item.description: Martin County saw two brush fires this week, including one sparked by a lightning strike. Both are now fully contained and being monitored by the Florida Forest Service.

item.title: New Aldi opens in Hobe Sound as shoppers look for ways to cut grocery costs
item.description: A new Aldi located at 8867 Southeast Bridge Road opened Thursday in Hobe Sound, bringing more affordable choices to customers facing tight budgets as grocery prices continue to rise.

item.title: Jensen Beach Orangetheory Fitness holds fundraiser for family of 5-year-old killed in bike accident
item.description: A Jensen Beach Orangetheory Fitness is raising funds for the family of Garrett Leonard, a 5-year-old boy who was killed when he was hit by a pickup truck while riding a bicycle at a motocross park in Miami.

item.title: Fort Pierce neighbors pack planning meeting over Causeway Cove high-rise development proposal
item.description: The Fort Pierce Planning Board reviewed the Causeway Cove development project Monday, which includes five high-rise buildings with one 17-story building standing 192 feet tall and more than 900 apartments and condos.

item.title: Port St. Lucie couple fights rezoning of lot behind their home, says voices went unheard
item.description: Joseph and Margaret Mucciolo opposed the Port St. Lucie City Council's unanimous vote to rezone the lot behind their home from residential to commercial, a change they fought for months.

item.title: Port St. Lucie neighbors express concerns over commercial rezoning near Tradition
item.description: Joseph and Margaret Mucciolo live along the edge of a nearly 9.5-acre property near Crosstown Parkway and SW Fairgreen Drive that is scheduled for a second reading and final vote before city council Monday.

item.title: Port St. Lucie's 6,000-seat soccer stadium groundbreaking planned for November
item.description: Port St. Lucie SC released new renderings this week of its 6,000-seat stadium to be built at the Walton & One development, a 46-acre mixed-use redevelopment project located along U.S. 1 and Walton Road.

item.title: Port St. Lucie teen named Southeast Region Youth of the Year surprised with FIFA World Cup finals trip
item.description: Enrique Rosario Liz was surprised at the Boys & Girls Club of St. Lucie County in Fort Pierce with the news that he will serve as one of 12 club members selected to be an official Coca-Cola flag bearer at the FIFA World Cup finals on July 19.

item.title: Neighbors worry proposed 85-acre development near I-95 will change St. Lucie County's rural landscape
item.description: The proposed Indrio Town Center off Indrio Road and Russakis Road would bring 447,250 square feet of commercial, retail and possible residential space to land near Interstate 95, with county commissioners expected to vote on rezoning in August.

item.title: Port St. Lucie Opens Registration for Free City University Program
item.description:
Registration is now open for Port St. Lucie City University, a free nine-session program designed to help residents better understand how their local government operates.

item.title: Two bodies found near Sebastian unconnected but considered suspicious, Indian River County sheriff says
item.description: Indian River County Sheriff Eric Flowers said two bodies found this week near U.S. Highway 1 near Sebastian appear unrelated but remain under investigation as suspicious deaths.

item.title: Vero Beach parents sue city over infant son's remains allegedly disturbed and reburied without consent
item.description: Adam Chrzan and Tanya Crovo allege their infant son's remains were disturbed during maintenance at Crestlawn Cemetery and reinterred without their knowledge.

item.title: Decomposed body found near U.S. Highway 1 near Sebastian, second in area this week
item.description: A heavily decomposed body was discovered Wednesday afternoon along the shoreline near 14510 U.S. Highway 1 near Sebastian, the second body found in the area this week.
